title: 会 + verb: can (a learned skill)
summary: Lets you say what you know how to do, as in 我会说汉语.
explanation:
会 + verb means 'can' in the sense of 'know how to', a skill you have learned: 我会说汉语 'I can speak Chinese', 他会开车 'He can drive.' The negative is 不会: 我不会做饭 'I can't cook.'

For permission ('may I?') Chinese uses 可以, not 会. 会 can also mean 'will (probably)', as in 明天会下雨 'It will rain tomorrow.'

mistakes.why: 会 is negated with 不.

why: 在 + verb would mean 'is driving now'.
会 takes 不, not 没.

exercises.prompt: Which asks 'Can you write Chinese characters?'
why: Correct: 会 + verb + object + 吗.
The object 汉字 comes after the verb 写.

exercises.why: 不会 goes before the verb.

exercises.prompt: Which word fits? 我___说一点儿汉语。 ('I can speak a little Chinese.')
why: Correct: speaking a language is a learned skill: 会.
是 doesn't go before verbs like this.
Correct: 会 can also mean 'will probably'.
可以 is permission; the weather doesn't ask permission.
在 + verb is 'is happening now', not tomorrow.
